description: This file provides database connection management and query execution utilities for a backend application, including a context manager for PostgreSQL connections and functions to fetch and execute queries.

methods.name: Iterator[psycopg.Connection] get_db()
methods.description: Provides a managed PostgreSQL database connection, yields a connection object, handles committing, rolling back, and closing.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None fetch_one(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a query and returns a single row as a dictionary or None if no result.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all resulting rows as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: None execute(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: tuple[Any, ...] = ())
methods.description: Executes a query without returning results (used for insert/update/delete).
